277-3227-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-3227-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-3227-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scrivener and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

243-628-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2646-4247--5.easyPrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2646-4247--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

222-527-6495-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-6965.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5003-7283-7649-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
5003-7283-7649-8095.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

728-1545-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:

You have 2 or more life.
728-1545-1981-2415.description:

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

When the creature token dies, Pestered Wellguard triggers, untapping Pestered Wellguard.

1594-2741-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.

3698-4907-6556-6989.description:

When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.

2292-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-5687-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Viscera Seer.

465-3742-4251-4452-4460.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5776-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4091-4785-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
4091-4785-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Repeat.

There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
1863-3617-4423-6886.description:

Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar

Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sky Hussar, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sky Hussar for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-6097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-6097.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

When the Servo enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

323-3097-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.

Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2511-2730-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
2511-2730-3719-5131.description:

When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.

Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Saffi ability.

Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reveillark, adding one mana of any color.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding one mana of any color.

Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.

224-765-2248.description:

When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
